AI Engineer (LLM Systems) at Northwind Analytics

Location: London, UK - hybrid, 3 days per week in our Shoreditch office

About us
Northwind Analytics builds decision-support tooling for the legal and insurance
sectors. We are a team of 40, profitable, and backed by a Series B round. We
offer a competitive salary, 28 days holiday, and a learning budget.

The role
You will join a small applied AI team taking retrieval systems from prototype to
production. Day-to-day you will design and ship RAG pipelines over large
document collections, build evaluation harnesses that tell us whether a change
actually helped, and work with product and legal stakeholders to turn fuzzy
requirements into measurable systems. You will own services end to end,
including deployment and monitoring.

What we're looking for
- Strong Python. You must have production experience, not just notebooks.
- Demonstrable experience building retrieval-augmented generation systems,
  including chunking strategies, embedding models and vector search.
- Proven track record with LLM evaluation: you have built eval harnesses and can
  talk about faithfulness, context recall and hallucination rates.
- Experience with vector databases such as Qdrant, Weaviate or pgvector.
- Required: comfort with Docker and deploying containerised services.
- You have worked with prompt engineering and understand its limits.
- Excellent stakeholder communication. You can explain a retrieval failure to a
  lawyer without jargon.

Nice to have
- Knowledge graphs and graph databases such as Neo4j.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes for orchestration.
- Exposure to fine-tuning open-weight models.
- Experience mentoring junior engineers.
- Publications or open-source contributions in NLP.

Tech you'll touch
Python, PyTorch, LangChain, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Qdrant, Docker, GitHub Actions,
and a monitoring stack built on Grafana. We run CI/CD on every merge.

Visa
We are unable to sponsor visas for this role. You must have the existing right
to work in the UK.

How to apply
Send a CV and a short note. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome
applications from all backgrounds.
